verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/passkey security key that works with no software or drivers. Generating AI insights and suggestions from user data inside the product is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability. The Shopify-generated llms.txt on the store is not a product feature and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
